# War Brokers Stats

> War Brokers Stats provides statistics for the first-person shooter game War Brokers.

## Statistics

- [Home](/): Player counts, live streams, and global player statistics.
- [Leaderboards](/leaderboard): Overview of the global player leaderboards.
- [Daily leaderboards](/leaderboard/daily): Player leaderboards for the current daily stats period.
- [Daily kills leaderboard](/leaderboard/daily/kills): Players ranked by kills earned yesterday.
- [Daily Classic Mode Wins leaderboard](/leaderboard/daily/classicModeWins): Players ranked by Classic Mode wins earned yesterday.
- [Daily Battle Royale Wins leaderboard](/leaderboard/daily/battleRoyaleWins): Players ranked by Battle Royale wins earned yesterday.
- [Games Elo leaderboard](/leaderboard/gamesELO): Players ranked by Games Elo.
- [Kills Elo leaderboard](/leaderboard/killsELO): Players ranked by Kills Elo.
- [Time Alive leaderboard](/leaderboard/timeAlive): Players ranked by total time alive.
- [XP leaderboard](/leaderboard/xp): Players ranked by experience points and level.
- [Ranks](/ranks): War Brokers player rank thresholds and badges.
- [Servers](/servers): Active War Brokers servers by region.
- [Squads](/squads): Squad rosters.
